_source: techval.ml.features.build_panel over the SEED universe plus the most-named peers outside it, at 1 January 2021 through 2026. Each row was built through a client pinned to the row date and proved with assert_point_in_time. No market feed: the keyless quote source serves about three years, so a 2021 date has no prices at all, and a panel carrying market features only at its late dates would hand a model a clean proxy for the calendar.
